result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both boards keep all 14 tanks and all ten columns on one screen, and both drop the crypto look for warm, brewery-appropriate styling. B has more compact summary counts and quieter normal rows. Its FV4 and FV7 alerts are consistent and easy to spot, and its bold, right-aligned figures read well, though its column headers are small and faint. A gives FV7 much heavier emphasis than FV4, and its boxed stage pills and taller count cards add visual noise. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both boards show all 14 tanks and all ten columns on one screen, and both drop the crypto look for a warm, brewery-like palette with a serif wordmark. A's summary strip is more compact, its stage markers are quieter, and it highlights FV4 and FV7 the same way, so they stand out cleanly against calm rows. B's header line listing the two flags is a nice touch, but its boxed, coloured stage pills on every row make normal rows busy, and its old-style figures in the tank IDs are slightly harder to read.
